## Task environment and bounded contribution

Challenge link and relevant issue (if any):

Package name/version and component changed (harness, tools, behaviors, system prompt, context, permissions, evaluation):

Describe the intended capability/behavior, source review, or test and what changed:

## Reproduce and evaluate

Source revision, exact commands or manual review steps, output location, and actual results:

Report correctness, evidence checks, and unknown preservation separately. Include failures, errors, blocked checks, and evaluation-answer exposure/tuning. Attach or link a completed `docs/RESULT_TEMPLATE.md` copy.

## Evidence and limits

Identify synthetic versus reviewed evidence, supporting citations, disputed labels, and Access domain review status. State what remains unknown. A potential fit does not establish seats, admission, eligibility, or outcomes.

## Runtime and resources

Model/version/parameter count/license/runtime, or no model; hardware; measured duration/CPU/GPU/memory and measurement method, or unmeasured. The <=1B versus proposed 7B policy remains unresolved; link any actual maintainer decision.

## Continuation

Progress handoff location and next bounded task:

- [ ] No personal records, credentials, private source exports, or model weights included
- [ ] Package references and contract respected, or coordinated changes explained
- [ ] Execution/isolation claims match the implemented and verified environment
- [ ] Citations and expected answers reviewed to the extent stated
- [ ] Evaluation exposure, failures, and blocked checks disclosed
- [ ] Third-party permissions and attribution identified; no new repository license assumed
- [ ] Results and resumable progress record included

Maintainers: use `docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md`. A merge records a reviewed experiment; deployment or real-world service guidance requires separate review.
